verdict.title: Review 2 caveats
verdict.message: Review the warnings below. A configuration check cannot prove a customer purchase and Internet access.

checks.label: How you collect
checks.detail: Your paybill 007500 is shown to customers, but payments sent to it are NOT captured and customers are NOT reconnected — a manual paybill has no API behind it. To automate this, add M-Pesa API credentials (Consumer Key, Consumer Secret, Passkey and Shortcode) for 007500 under Settings → Payments; C2B then registers itself and payments reconnect customers within seconds. Until then, reconcile with Import Statement on this page.

checks.label: Payments matched to a customer
checks.detail: Every payment resolved to a customer.

checks.label: Every package carries a speed
checks.detail: All packages have a download speed.

checks.label: Customers waiting to be connected
checks.detail: No pending provisioning jobs. Check live router sessions separately.

checks.label: Paid customer access records
checks.detail: No completed hotspot payments in the last 7 days. End-to-end purchase remains unverified.

checks.label: Stuck M-Pesa transactions
checks.detail: Every transaction older than 10 minutes has a final result.

checks.label: Database is up to date
checks.detail: No missing migrations on this installation.

checks.label: Background jobs running
checks.detail: Payment confirmation, provisioning retry and expiry enforcement are all current.
